sources.location: HTTP range reads (first 64 KB) of the 14 yeast RAW files under ftp://ftp.pride.ebi.ac.uk/pride/data/archive/2015/06/PXD002277/; extracted strings in sdrf-skills/scratchpad/PXD002277/rawhdr_summary.txt
Deposited RAW file names in the PRIDE file list

claims.evidence: PRIDE lists NEWT:4932; the yeast search used the fasta yeast_orf_trans_all_05-Jan-2010.fasta; raw_list maps these 14 files to the yeast tables S3 and S8; the abstract names S. cerevisiae
Exactly these 14 raw files are listed in yeast_succinylation/summary.txt and attributed to Tables S3 and S8 in List_of_RAW_files.xlsx; all are present in the PRIDE file list
summary.txt gives Multiplicity 1 with no Labels1/Labels2 for the six Yeast40_succK_pH* files

claims.value: SILAC light / SILAC medium / SILAC heavy
claims.evidence: summary.txt gives Multiplicity 3, Labels1 = Lys4 and Labels2 = Lys8 for all 8 SCX files; raw_list notes 'SILAC, as indicated in file name'

claims.location: characteristics[genotype], characteristics[growth condition] and the matching factor values, rows 7-30
claims.value: light = wild type/glucose; medium = wild type/galactose; heavy = kgd mutant/galactose (kgd files) or lsc mutant/galactose (lsc files)
claims.evidence: File-name tokens wtDEX0 / wtGAL4 / kgdGAL8 and lscGAL8 (raw_list says the SILAC design is as indicated in the file name), matched to the label order Lys0/Lys4/Lys8 in summary.txt; the abstract states that growth conditions and succinyl-CoA metabolism mutations were compared. Gene identities behind 'kgd'/'lsc' are not stated

claims.location: characteristics[genotype], characteristics[growth condition] and factor values, rows 1-6
claims.evidence: No source gives the strain or carbon source for the label-free Yeast40 sample

claims.value: 1 for all sources; wild-type channels of the kgd and lsc mixes keep separate source names but are not claimed as independent replicates
claims.evidence: Two separate SILAC mixes, each with its own wild-type glucose and galactose channels; treating them as independent cultures is an inference

The b-files share the stem of an original and were acquired with BTW_120m_60ms_250ms2_.meth (120 min) instead of 150min_3tunes_nolockmass_Iso2_Res35000_IT120.meth, consistent with re-injection of the same fraction

claims.value: 1-3 (pH45, pH5, pH11) for label-free; 1-4 (SCX_01..04) for SILAC
claims.evidence: PRIDE protocol: enriched peptides 'immediately separated by micro-scale SCX chromatography'; fraction tokens are taken from the file names and ordered by elution pH or index
PRIDE sample-processing protocol names micro-scale SCX; the SILAC file names contain 'SCX'
PRIDE instrument MS:1001911; RAW headers read 'Q Exactive - Orbitrap MS' (QE3 and QE4 units); summary.txt Instrument column reads Q Exactive

claims.location: comment[proteomics data acquisition method], comment[dissociation method], comment[ms2 mass analyzer] rows 1-30
claims.value: Data-dependent acquisition; beam-type CID (HCD, MS:1000422); orbitrap (MS:1000484)
claims.evidence: The PRIDE protocol says the Q-Exactive was 'operated ... in the data-dependent mode', that peptides were fragmented by HCD, and that the 'orbitrap analyzer used for fragment scans'
summary.txt Protease column gives Trypsin/P for all 14 files; the PRIDE prose says 'strict trypsin specificity, up to 2 missed cleavages' (tools reconcile flags the wording difference)

claims.location: comment[precursor mass tolerance], comment[fragment mass tolerance] rows 1-30
claims.evidence: PRIDE data-processing protocol: 'mass tolerance of 6 ppm for parent ions and 20 ppm (HCD) for fragment ions'; parameters.txt gives MS/MS tol. (FTMS) 20 ppm

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Oxidation M, Acetyl Protein N-term and Succinyl K variable
claims.evidence: parameters.txt fixed modification Carbamidomethyl (C); summary.txt variable modifications Oxidation (M);Acetyl (Protein N-term);succinyl-K

claims.value: Label:2H(4) K and Label:13C(6)15N(2) K on SILAC rows 7-30; not applicable on label-free rows 1-6
claims.evidence: Labels1 = Lys4 and Labels2 = Lys8 for the multiplicity-3 files, none for the multiplicity-1 files; set by the documented postprocess.py, with a diff showing exactly 12 cells changed

limitations: Paper full text unavailable (not in PMC; cell.com and ScienceDirect returned 403); only the PubMed abstract and the PRIDE protocol texts were used
SILAC channel-to-condition map inferred from file-name tokens (DEX0/GAL4/GAL8, kgd/lsc) plus the MaxQuant label order; List_of_RAW_files.xlsx says only 'as indicated in file name'
Genes and alleles behind 'kgd mutant' and 'lsc mutant' not established; strain background not available
Growth condition (glucose/galactose) inferred from DEX/GAL tokens; media details not available
Biological replicate numbering of the wild-type channels across the two SILAC mixes assumes independent cultures
Genotype and growth condition of the label-free Yeast40 sample not available
b-files interpreted as re-injections (technical replicate 2) from RAW-header method names, not from an explicit statement
Elution pH of the 'pH5' fraction (5 vs 5.5) unconfirmed
Reduction and alkylation reagents not available
Antibody enrichment step not encoded as an SDRF column
Trypsin/P taken from MaxQuant output while the PRIDE prose says 'strict trypsin specificity'; tools reconcile reports cleavage_agent_unsupported

Whether the kgd-mix and lsc-mix wild-type channels came from independent cultures is not documented; both are biological replicate 1 with mix-specific source names. The antibody enrichment could use the optional characteristics[enrichment process] column but no specific term exists.
